program_name: Bachelor in Information and Communication Technology (Hons)

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM81,005. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0004680/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass in Matriculation or Foundation studies with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent; OR Pass in STPM or its equivalent, with a minimum of Grade C (GPA 2.00) in any 2 subjects and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent; OR Diploma in Computer Science / Software Engineering / Information Technology / Information Systems or equivalent with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 and credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent; OR Any other Diploma in science and technology or business studies with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 may be admitted, subject to a rigorous internal assessment process and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent. Candidates with CGPA below 2.5 but above 2.0 with a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent may be admitted, subject to a rigorous internal assessment process. The credit in Mathematics at SPM level can be waived if the qualification contains equivalent or higher-level Mathematics. Candidates with a credit in computing-related subject at SPM or STPM level or equivalent may be given preferential consideration. International students must have IELTS score of 6.0 or equivalent.
